newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares mixed, trade concentrated.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares mixed, trade concentrated.

text.p: 1230 GMT - Portuguese shares were mixed with interest concentrated in a handful of shares before the long Easter weekend.
*Oporto derivatives market closed until Tuesday. Lisbon bourse closed Friday and Monday.

*Cimpor fell 46 escudos to stand at 3,464 with 151,938 shares traded. Dealers said the stock had fallen on disappointment that the cement group had not proposed a higher dividend on its strong 1996 results.

*BTA rose 105 escudos to 2,490 with volume of 95,800 on expectations that the bank might propose a higher dividend than the 135 escudos per share it originally announced. BTA shareholders' assembly is taking place today.

*Inparsa, a holding group with includes Sonae Industria and Pargeste, rose 54 escudos to 1,534 with 168,837 shares traded. Dealers said investors were optimistic about the wood sector and about prospects for the holding company which began trading on March 21.
*Sonae Investimentos fell prey to foreign selling and lost 69 escudos to stand at 5,669 with turnover of 41,886.
